tools.name: stamp
tools.description: Explicitly create an unlisted hash-only receipt via createMoment; not an evaluation tool. No file upload. May be pending/429; no retry. Need more than the free rate? Email morris@mifalai.com with the hash and the use.

tools.name: verify
tools.description: cite slug@height only when status confirmed and proofFile exists; else refuse. Read existing receipt, no creation; metadata check, not local OTS cryptographic verification. Before citing: call verify or first_at. Cite only status confirmed with proofFile; otherwise refuse. You may attach the .ots UR

tools.name: first_at
tools.description: cite slug@height only when status confirmed and proofFile exists; else refuse. Read earliest public receipt; recheck verify before citing.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: verify · Private data: stamp · Public sink: stamp.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: verify · Private data: stamp · Public sink: stamp

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.

findings.title: Tool description changed since last scan
